2026 Undergraduate Admission Brochure for International Students Degree Programs (Taught in English) Shanghai University of Electric Power (SUEP), founded in 1951, is a full- time institution of higher education, jointly constructed by China’s central government and Shanghai Municipal Government. SUEP is a comprehensive university with distinguishing features and advantages in the field of Energy and Electric Power, which also provides professional courses in various fields, including Engineering, Science, Management, Economics, Arts and other disciplines.The university offers 3 national-level chara- cteristic majors, 5 national-level first-class undergraduate majors, 1 pilot reform major of Ministry of Education and 12 Shanghai municipal-level first-class undergraduate majors.I. Catalog of Undergraduate Programs (English-taught) International Economy and Trade II. Period of Schooling The normal period of study for undergraduate program is 4 years. Students are required to complete the curriculum plan within 4 to 6 years and fulfill the designated number of credits. III. Qualifications i. Applicants should be over 18 years old and in good health. ii. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For those who were Chinese citizens before becoming foreign nationals, the document No.12 [2020] issued by the Ministry of Education will be followed iii. Applicants must have obtained the senior high school diploma. IV. Application Materials (Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with original notarized Chinese or English translations.) i. Senior high school official Graduation Certificate or equivalent diploma. Non- fresh graduate needs to provide the Certificate of the highest academic degree or Resume of work experience after graduation. ii. Original Transcripts of senior high school or equivalent. Non- fresh graduate provides the Original transcripts of the highest academic degree. The transcripts should cover all the courses have been studied. iii. IELTS 5 .5 or TOEFL 60 (or above); Native English speakers are exempted from the language requirement. iv. Study Plan in China.v. Scanned copy of the home page of valid Passport (valid in two years or longer). vi. Applicants who are already in China should submit the scanned copy of the visa page and residence permit page of passport, as well as the Performance Certificate issued by current school. vii. White background passport-size photo (image format JPG). viii. Guarantee Statement (Annex) & Bank assets certification (over RMB4,500). ix. Physical Examination Records for Foreigner. x. Certificate of Non-Criminal Record. *Note :Applicants should ensure the application contents and the attached documents are true and valid. Those who are dishonest will be permanently disqualified from applying for SUEP. V. Deadline for Application: June 30th , 2026 VI. Application Procedure Open the International Students Application System http://icsm.shiep.edu.cn/internationalEducationStudent and register via your e-mail. 360 browser or Chrome is recommended. You will receive a confirmation e-mail once finishing registration. You should click the link in the e-mail to activate your account. VII. Expenses Major Tuition fee Accommodation fee Insurance fee International 4500 RMB/ Year Economy and 20000 RMB/ 800 RMB/ Year ( double room) Year TradeVIII. Scholarship  SUEP provides Shanghai Government Scholarship (SGS) Class B, applicants will enjoy free tuition and comprehensive medical insurance.  SUEP also provides University Scholarship Class C :tuition waiver 12,000 RMB.  Each student can only apply for one type of scholarship each year. IX. Accommodation Please make a reservation for accommodation in advance if you would like to live on campus. We will offer dorms to freshmen who have submitted campus dorm applications. If there are any dorms left, they will be available to senior students who need accommodation.The accommodation expenses will be determined by accommodation conditions when applying for accommodation. X. Insurance International students are required to purchase the Comprehensive Insurance Plan of Foreign Students provided by Ping An Insurance Company, which has been recognized and recommended by the Chinese Ministry of Education. Students who do not have valid medical insurance are not allowed to register. The insurance fee is 800RMB/ year. Please visit www.lxbx.net. to get detailed information and download related materials. XI. Contacts International Exchange and Cooperation Office Address: Room 1017 Graphic information Building, No.1851 Huchenghuan Road, Pudong District, Shanghai, P.R.
